context_for_next_testing_agent: ShareMenu feature is complete. Admin user now has anonymous_alias. Dashboard ShareMenu only visible for Sonhador level users - Embaixador users don't see it because they've already completed the invite requirements. This is intentional design, not a bug.

notes.dashboard_behavior: The ShareMenu in Dashboard.js at lines 462-477 is conditionally rendered: `{!isEmbaixador && dashboardData?.user_alias && (`. This means Embaixador level users don't see the invite link section because they've already met the requirements.
notes.anonymous_alias_requirement: JourneyDetail ShareMenu requires user?.anonymous_alias to be set. New users via Google OAuth auto-generate one, but users created via password registration may need to generate it via /api/profile/generate-anonymous endpoint.
